results.description: Collection of lookup results from each provider that returned a match.

lookedUpAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this lookup was performed.

main.description: Result of parsing and looking up media links across supported music streaming providers.

url.description: Direct web link to the track or album on the provider's platform.

title.description: Official title of the track or album as listed in the provider's catalog.

artUrl.description: URL to the cover artwork image.

artist.description: Primary artist name for the track or album artist.

isAlbum.description: True for albums/EPs, false for individual tracks.

externalId.description: ISRC (for tracks) or UPC (for albums) identifier for cross-platform matching.

marketRegion.description: ISO3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the market/storefront.

providerResult.description: Music metadata from a specific provider's API query.

schema.description: Unified BridgeBeats lookup result aggregating links across music service providers.
